sources.title: Hebei Daily: Haoyang Langfang No. 1 operating campus
sources.summary: Named operations director Yin Chunhui explains that customer staff in Building B support day-to-day live business. Recent site observations corroborate operation. The exact visit date is unstated; No. 2 is a separate future construction project in this report.
